name: Suou Kazuhiko
source:
Kazuhiko is a second-year male student of Mihoshi Academy and is the protagonist of the story. He was left an orphan in his childhood, and was adopted by an old woman named [url=/c7536]Hina Suoh[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hoshiuta#Supporting_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
